payload.description: The consultation report for the allocations half. The report to Cabinet says the responses “will be published, along with council comments, in an online report”. For the homelessness strategy that happened: a public consultation report sits on the consultation page as Appendix A, and in the Cabinet papers as Annex D to the strategy report taken the same evening. For Home Options there is no equivalent. What has been published for it is the agree / disagree / neutral percentages in Appendix C and the council's short “you said, we did” note. What people actually wrote is still unpublished.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 7 September 2026
